articles.headline: Attack, attack, attack: N.E.C. Nijmegen's tactics have to be seen to be believed
articles.description: NEC have the most attacking, aggressive style around, and it's working as they sit third in the Dutch Eredivisie and are into the final of the Dutch Cup.

articles.headline: Go Ahead Eagles beat AZ Alkmaar in shootout to win first Dutch Cup
articles.description: Go Ahead Eagles won their first ever Dutch KNVB Cup on Sunday, coming from behind to score a last-gasp equaliser before going on to win 4-2 on penalties after a 1-1 draw with AZ Alkmaar.

articles.headline: Ajax suffer shock Dutch Cup loss to 4th-tier amateurs Hercules
articles.description: Ajax Amsterdam's poor season went from bad to worse after they suffered one of the biggest shocks in their history with a 3-2 loss to fourth-tier amateur side USV Hercules in the last 32 of the Dutch Cup on Thursday.

images.name: Ajax woe vs. Hercules_20231221 [1296x729]
images.alt: Georges Mikautadze of Ajax after the 2nd round of the KNVB Cup match between USV Hercules (am) and Ajax in Galgenwaard stadium on December 21, 2023 in Utrecht, the Netherlands.

articles.headline: PSV Eindhoven beat Ajax to defend Dutch Cup title
articles.description: Fabio Silva struck the winning penalty as PSV Eindhoven defended their Dutch Cup title with a 3-2 shootout victory against Ajax Amsterdam.

images.name: PSV trophy lift Dutch Cup_230430 [1296x729]
images.caption: PSV Eindhoven players celebrate after beating Ajax in a shootout to win the Dutch Cup.
images.alt: PSV Eindhoven players celebrate after beating Ajax in a shootout to win the Dutch Cup.

articles.headline: Ajax's Davy Klaassen injured by object thrown from crowd in Dutch Cup semifinal
articles.description: Dutch Cup semifinal between Feyenoord and Ajax was suspended for 28 minutes after an object thrown from the crowd hit the head of Davy Klaassen.

articles.headline: USMNT's Ricardo Pepi scores 5th goal in 6 games for FC Groningen
articles.description: American forward Ricardo Pepi got his fifth goal in six games for Groningen, scoring in a 3-0 win at Dordrecht in the first round of the Dutch Cup.
